versions.content: If the UdpNm performs a state change from BusSleep state or PrepareBusSleep state to NetworkMode due to a call to UdpNm_NetworkRequest() (i.e. due to an active wakeup) and UdpNmActiveWakeupBitEnabled is TRUE, the UdpNm shall set the ActiveWakeupBit in the CBV.
